text: Traveling to a new country is an exciting experience. Planning a trip can be fun, but it also takes time. You need to choose where to go, book a hotel, and decide what to see. When you arrive, everything feels different. You meet new cultures, try delicious food, and hear people speaking a language you may not understand. Language barriers can be difficult, but you can use gestures or simple words to communicate. These moments often become the best memories of your journey. Traveling teaches you about the world and about yourself, and you return home with stories to share.
